critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7018 lines; RBAC config (VALID_ROLES, MENU_KEYS, PATH_MENU_RULES, RBAC_BYPASS_PREFIXES, rbac_middleware) is co-located inline. Consider extracting to /app/backend/rbac.py module for maintainability.

PATH_MENU_RULES prefix matching is ordered — first-match-wins. Docstring/comment already notes 'most specific first', good. Ensure new sub-routes are added ABOVE parent prefixes (e.g., /api/sales/report before /api/sales) — currently correct.
Users.jsx UserFormModal is inline (~170 lines). Not urgent but could be extracted to /pages/users/UserFormModal.jsx.
Console: /api/auth/me returns 401 on the /login page (expected — no session). This is fine but noisy. Could suppress via a client-side flag skipping /auth/me when path=/login.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings still appear across dashboard — unrelated to RBAC, tracked from iter 33.

Middleware allows unauthenticated requests to fall through (returns call_next when no token / invalid token) — relying on endpoint's Depends(get_current_user) to enforce 401. This is intentional but be aware: if any /api endpoint (outside bypass list) forgets its auth Depends, it would be unprotected. Consider adding a hardening step: return 401 from middleware if token missing on non-bypass /api paths.
